title: AnotherHeadDrop
description: Another head drop plugin, but now with looting configuration.
body:
This is a plugin that make player head drops.

The main difference between this and other player head plugin are configurable looting bonus and drops from non player kill.


All chances (in percentage) can be configure in `plugins/AnotherHeadDrop/config.yml`.

Note white this plugin is built with Spigot API, it has only been tested with paper.
